_comment: Route weights derived from DGCA domestic city-pair passenger traffic data.
source: Vonter/india-aviation-traffic (https://github.com/Vonter/india-aviation-traffic), licensed ODbL-1.0. Data sourced from DGCA.
methodology: Passenger shares computed over the 12-month window 2025-01 to 2026-05 from aggregated/domestic/city.csv. PaxToCity2 + PaxFromCity2 summed across all months for each city pair, then restricted to the 12-route APIx basket and normalised to sum to 1.0. City names mapped to IATA codes: DELHI=DEL, MUMBAI/MUMBAI(MUMBAI)/MUMBAI(NAVI MUMBAI)=BOM, BENGALURU=BLR, KOLKATA=CCU, CHENNAI=MAA, HYDERABAD=HYD, GOA/GOA(DABOLIM,SOUTH GOA)/GOA(MOPA,NORTH GOA)/MOPA,GOA=GOI.
